title: Maurice Hill's jellyfish-shaped UFO

tellings.quote: hearing this groundskeeper Maurice Hill saying that he himself had had an up close and personal encounter with a jellyfish shaped UFO

plain: Around 1973 or 1974, in the Washington DC area, a groundskeeper named Maurice Hill says he had a close-up encounter with a UFO shaped like a jellyfish. Michels tells this in his documentary about Lue Elizondo, passing on what he heard Hill say about his own encounter. He offers it as one of the up-close accounts that drew people into the subject.
